prompt: Review the conclusion in the imported file 'conclusion.md'. Is it justified by the evidence it gives?

documents.title: A/B test conclusion
documents.text:
# Conclusion
Our A/B test proves conclusively that the new onboarding flow increases retention for all users. We recommend shipping it everywhere immediately.

Details: 38 users per arm, one week of data, mobile app only. Seven-day retention was 47% for the new flow and 34% for the old flow (p = 0.09).

truth: No. The text says the test 'proves conclusively' that the new flow increases retention 'for all users', but it reports n = 38 per arm, one week of data, p = 0.09 and mobile users only. p = 0.09 does not meet the usual 0.05 threshold; the sample is small; one week is short for retention; and mobile-only results do not extend to all users. A good review criticises the unsupported certainty and scope, keeps these limitations visible, and suggests a more accurate wording or further testing, without swinging to the opposite claim that the flow does not work.
